description: Defines data structures, enums, and classes related to table entries and tables for the 'lshal' namespace, including TableEntry, Table, and MergedTable, with associated methods and external dependencies.

classes.name: TableEntry
classes.description: Represents a row in a table with information about a specific service or interface, including methods for comparison, string representation, and retrieving specific fields.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Manages a collection of TableEntry objects, supports adding entries, selecting columns, and generating text-based table representations.

classes.name: MergedTable
classes.description: Combines multiple Table instances into a single text representation.

methods.name: to_string(ServiceStatus s)
methods.description: Converts a ServiceStatus enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: TableEntry::getThreadUsage
methods.description: Returns a string representing thread usage as 'usage/count' or 'N/A' if count is zero.

methods.name: TableEntry::isReleased
methods.description: Returns a string indicating whether the service is released based on hash and other fields.

methods.name: TableEntry::getVintfInfo
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the VintfInfo field.

methods.name: TableEntry::getField
methods.description: Returns a string for a specified column type.

methods.name: Table::createTextTable
methods.description: Generates a TextTable object representing the table's data, optionally formatted neatly and with debug info.

methods.name: MergedTable::createTextTable
methods.description: Creates a combined TextTable from multiple tables.
